cartridges.title: SG-1000 M2 Check Program (1984)
cartridges.source: external/SG-1000/5 Programs & Tools.zip, member SG-1000 M2 Test Cartridge (Japan).sg
cartridges.exercises: its sound screen sounds each tone channel and then the noise channel in turn, naming the one it means on screen

pages.SOUND TEST: stimulus only: the program sounds each channel in turn for a person to hear and reports no verdict. What is held here is what the part was set to while each CHANNEL screen was up: period 0B3h on the named tone channel at attenuation 0, then white noise, and every other channel off
pages.SCRATCH RAM, VDP V-RAM: the program's own verdicts, held by ti-tms9918-python; recorded here only as the screens it showed

cartridges.title: Sound Test 1.1, by Nicolas Warren
cartridges.source: external/Master EverDrive/5 Tools & Service Test Carts.zip
cartridges.exercises: stimulus only: an interactive editor for the three tone periods and volumes and the noise type, rate and volume, driven by the joypad; it reports no verdict. With no input it rewrites its starting values every frame, and the screen it draws, Freq: $3FF and Vol: $F on every channel, is what the part has to hold
cartridges.board: member 2's SG-1000 board. The program was written for a machine with 8K of RAM and Mode 4, and draws nothing readable here; with no input it writes its starting values every frame from the tenth on, 9F 8F 3F, BF AF 3F, DF CF 3F, then FF and a noise byte, EFh on the first pass and E2h after

cartridges.title: Test Suite 0.32 by sverx, its Audio Tests page
cartridges.source: external/Master EverDrive/5 Tools & Service Test Carts.zip
cartridges.exercises: stimulus only: PSGlib playback of each channel and a volume ramp, chosen from a Mode 4 menu with the joypad; no verdict in the image
cartridges.why: reaching the page takes joypad presses through a menu drawn in Mode 4; member 2's board has neither the controller ports nor Mode 4
